sections.title: Morning Shift — Team 1 (06:30 – 14:30)
items: Equipment received: 2 x Swipe Cards, 5 sets of keys, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 1 x Bodycam. (All photos and videos provided at the end of the shift.)
Arrived on site; briefing with the night team.
Briefing over, with nothing to report for us.
Call received from Queen Street McDonald's requesting assistance with a male vagrant; heading over to assist.

Arrived; initially assumed the vagrants sleeping out front were the issue, but a male vagrant had come in and left wearing no clothes. Heading out to look for the person of interest. (Photos of the sleeping vagrants on file.)
Arrived at the corner of Mayoral Drive and Queen Street; no sign of the person of interest after visual sweeps. Standing by for security presence.
No sign of the person of interest; continuing patrols through Lorne Street.
Lorne Street all clear; heading towards High Street.
Vulcan Lane and High Street all clear; heading around to O'Connell Street for a welfare check.
O'Connell Street and Freyberg Square all clear; checking in on Chancery Square.
Chancery Square all clear; standing by for security presence.
Pocket Park, Fort Lane, Fort Street, Wilson Carpark, Jo & Joes, Right Track and 77 Convenience Store all clear; standing by for security presence.
Heading to check in on Gore Street.
Gore Street, including Auckland Harbour Suites, all clear; standing by for security presence.
Arrived at Britomart McDonald's and completed welfare checks on 77 Convenience Store and Custom Mart — all clear, as is Britomart McDonald's. Heading to check on TK Square and Commercial Bay.
TK Square and Commercial Bay all clear; standing by for security presence.
Heading to check on Woolworths Lower Albert Street and Aotea Gifts.
All clear at both locations; heading up Albert Street.
Welfare check at Albert Mart, all clear; continuing patrol.
Arrived and completed a welfare check on the Cathedral; area all clear. Standing by for security presence.
Heading towards the corner of Victoria Street and Federal Street.
Arrived at the corner of Victoria Street and Federal Street; welfare check completed with no issues, then standing by for security presence:
Heading towards Elliott Street via Federal Street.
Welfare check on Elliott Street and Darby Street, all clear, nothing to report. Standing by at Lumi Cafe for security presence.
Heading onto Queen Street to conduct welfare checks on stores.
Welfare check on surrounding businesses from Ippondo to NZ Muscle, then Acceco down to Starbucks, all clear. Checking on Puffing Kiwi and surrounding stores.
Welfare checks at Puffing Kiwi, Sail City Convenience and Look Sharp, nothing to report. Standing by for security presence.
Heading down Queen Street towards Britomart.
Welfare checks on stores from Mecca and Farmers down to Glassons and 2degrees, nothing to report. Heading onto Durham Street for welfare checks.
Durham Street all clear; checks on Midtown Mini Mart, BBQ King restaurant and the Wilson carparks, no issues. Standing by for security presence.
Heading down Queen Street to continue patrol.
Welfare checks from UGG and Dunkin Donuts down to Hallensteins and OPSM, nothing to report. Checking in on Chemist Warehouse.
Welfare check at Chemist Warehouse, all clear, no issues. Standing by for security presence.
Call received from Cotton On requesting assistance — a potential shoplifter is in store, and they also asked for help with the lady outside their store. Heading there now.

Arrived at the store and stopped the person of interest, but he had no items on him — staff realised this after we asked him to empty his pockets and conducted a pat-down. He left with no issues to report. We then asked the female vagrant outside to move further away from the door, and she complied. Standing by for security presence.
Call received from Mecca regarding a female vagrant outside their entrance with a small pug dog, deterring customers from entering. Heading over to assist.
Assisted as best we could by attempting to move the female vagrant along, but she was not complying. Standing by for security presence in the hope of deterring her.
Heading to Britomart to finish off our patrol.
Arrived at Vulcan Lane; welfare check on stores including Kathmandu, Macpac, JB Hi-Fi and New Balance, nothing to report. Checking in on Vulcan Lane.
Vulcan Lane all clear; standing by for security presence.
Call received from Giapo Gore Street requesting assistance with vagrants trying to force their way into the store.

Arrived; the vagrants in question were leaving. One intoxicated male individual was lying on the ground (Photo on file); an ambulance arrived to collect him and assist him with sobering up (Photo on file). Ensured the vagrants had left the area and that staff felt comfortable enough to continue working. Heading back to the office for a break.

sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:30 – 21:48)
items: Equipment received: 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 1 x Bodycam, 5 x Keys. (All photos and videos provided at the end of the shift.)
Charging the Ops Phone, which is at 5%; will still respond to calls.
Heading to respond to a call from High Street — an elderly member of the public is asking for help.
Arrived; an elderly man named AJ, visiting from Christchurch, was having a hard time finding his car. We located him at the High Street carpark.

Asked him to enter his licence plate into the carpark system to check whether the vehicle was in that specific carpark; it was not found in the system, so we escorted him to Kitchener Street and located his vehicle. (Video on file.) Standing by until the gentleman had sorted out his affairs.
AJ has left and given his thanks. Making our way down towards Fort Lane. (Video on file.)
Full sweep of Fort Lane with welfare checks on all stores within the area, all clear. Patrolling down to Britomart.
Arrived at Britomart; commencing a sweep of the area.
Full sweep of Britomart; welfare check at McDonald's and the Commercial Bay shopping centre, all clear. Patrolling to Albert Street.
Lower Albert Street all clear, no issues. Patrolling up Albert Street.
Welfare check at the Albert Mart store, all clear.
Full sweep of Albert Street; welfare check at Eleven Angels bar and others, all clear, no issues. Patrolling down Swanson Street to Federal Square.
Arrived at Federal Square; commencing a sweep of the area.
Full sweep of Federal Square; welfare check at the Square Centre, Indingo, the Cathedral and Liston House, all clear, no issues. Patrolling down Wyndham Street.
Full sweep of Wyndham Street; welfare check at QFTAV bar, Chemist Warehouse, Melba and all others, all clear, no issues. Patrolling up to Queen Street.
Full sweep of Queen Street; patrolling Elliott Street and Darby Street.
Full sweep of Darby Street; welfare check at Malithai and Celine's, all clear. Patrolling the Elliott Stables area.
Full sweep of Elliott Street; welfare check at Tank, Domino's, Burger Express, Smashed Potatoes, Mr Snack and Chicken n Chips n Fish, all clear. Maintaining presence at Elliott Stables.
Welfare check with the Elliott Stables guard, all clear, no issues. Patrolling to Headquarters.
Arrived at Headquarters; commencing a 10-minute break.
Floor checks completed; commencing toilet break.
Toilet break over, no issues; gearing up to commence patrols.
Full sweep of upper Queen Street; welfare check, all clear, no issues; patrolling up Wellesley Street:
Welfare check on Wellesley Street, all clear, no issues. Patrolling through Lorne Street.
Welfare check at Red Radisson and the Lorne staircase mural, all clear.
The whole of Lorne Street all clear, no issues to report. Patrolling down High Street.
Arrived at Freyberg Place; commencing a sweep of the area.
Full sweep of Freyberg Place and Chancery Square; welfare check on O'Connell Street, Chancery Street and all open businesses in the area, all clear.
Full sweep of Vulcan Lane, all clear, no issues to report.
The whole of High Street all clear, no issues identified.
Welfare check on Shortland Street, Shortland Mart, Taco Bell and Haven Mart, all clear, no issues.
Welfare check at Jo & Joes, The Right Track, Mr Murdochs, KFC, Vape Haven and the Fort Street Wilson Carpark, all clear. Patrolling down Fort Lane to Britomart.
Fort Lane all clear, no issues identified; arriving at Britomart.
Arrived at Britomart; commencing a sweep of the area.
Full sweep of Britomart, no issues identified; welfare check at McDonald's and Customs Q Convenience Store, all clear. Heading back to Headquarters to commence break.
Arrived at Headquarters; commencing a 30-minute break (20:31 – 21:00).
Break completed; standing by in the office awaiting guard handover.
Requested by Management to deliver a shirt to a fellow guard at the Viaduct; en route to the location.
Currently standing by at the Viaduct.
Afternoon shift completed; handing over to the Night Shift.

sections.title: Night Shift (21:48 – 06:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio. (All photos and videos provided at the end of the shift.)
Night shift deployed; charging the Ops Phone due to low percentage.
Standing by at HQ charging the Ops Phone (22:00 – 23:15).
Maintaining presence at the Darby Street station.
Darby Street and Bar 101 all clear at this time, no issues to report. Patrolling Queen Street.
Full sweep of Wyndham Street, all clear, no issues to report.
Vulcan Lane all clear, no issues to report.
On standby at Shortland Street / Mothership showing security presence.
Shortland Street and Mothership all clear, no issues to report.
Queen Street full sweep complete, all clear, no issues to report.
Welfare check at Britomart McDonald's, all clear, no issues to report.
Check-in at Reign & Pour, all clear, no issues.

Welfare checks conducted at Lula Inn, Danny Doolans and Rosie's; there was a fight at Rosie's — managed to separate the parties, no further issues. Heading back to Darby Street at the manager's request.
Arrived at Darby Street; big groups present. On standby showing presence.
Big crowd outside Darby as the event has ended; on standby at Darby Street showing security presence.
Darby Street station crowd has cleared out; patrolling to Headquarters to let a fellow guard into the office until his ride arrives.
Let the fellow guard up to Level 1, no issues; continuing patrols up Victoria Street.
Victoria Street all clear, no issues. Patrolling down Albert Street.
Arrived at Ace Karaoke; standing by maintaining presence.
Welfare check at Ace Karaoke Bar, all clear. Patrolling down Wyndham Street.
Wyndham Street all clear, no issues. Patrolling up Queen Street.
Queen Street all clear, no issues. Patrolling Darby Street.
Darby Street all clear, no issues. Standing by at Bar 101 for any issues.
Bar 101 has closed; standing by until the crowd clears away.
Crowd has cleared; patrolling up Elliott Street to Wellesley Street.
Elliott Street all clear, no issues. Patrolling down Wellesley Street.
Wellesley Street all clear. Patrolling down Lorne Street.
Welfare check at Red Radisson and the Lorne staircase mural centre, all clear.
Full sweep of Lorne Street, all clear, no issues.
Arrived at Freyberg Place; commencing a sweep of the area.
Full sweep of Freyberg Place, O'Connell Street and Chancery Street, all clear. Patrolling down High Street.
Full sweep of Vulcan Lane, all clear, no issues.
Full sweep of the whole of High Street, no issues confirmed. Patrolling down Fort Lane.
Welfare check on Shortland Street, all clear, no issues to report.
Full sweep of Fort Lane; welfare check at Jo & Joes and the Fort Street Wilson Carpark, all clear, no issues. Arriving at Britomart.
Arrived at Britomart; commencing a sweep of the area.
Full sweep of Britomart; welfare check at McDonald's and with staff, all clear. Heading back to Headquarters to commence a 30-minute break.
Arrived at Headquarters; commencing the 30-minute break.
Break completed; awaiting guard handover in the office.
Night shift concluded; handing over to the Morning Shift.

flags: SENSITIVE: 11:54 Cotton On — team physically stopped ("grabbed") a suspected shoplifter and conducted a pocket-empty and pat-down search; no stolen items were found and the individual left without issue.
CAPACITY: Night Shift patrols did not commence until 23:30 — Ops Phone on low percentage, charging at HQ from deployment at 21:48 (team available for calls only).

STALE: 17:27 afternoon raw entry reads 'arrived at britomart maintaining presence', but the 17:45–18:16 entries show the team still at Elliott Stables; 'Britomart' appears to be a slip and the entry has been rendered as Elliott Stables.
